fluff.overview: Conventional infantry within the FWLM serve as the backbone of provincial defense across a patchwork of semi-autonomous states, each maintaining its own military traditions and equipment preferences. Wheeled mechanized platoons in FWLM service ride armored personnel carriers that offer good road speed and reasonable protection, making them well-suited to the League's developed industrial worlds where paved infrastructure supports rapid deployment between population centers. Armed with man-portable flamers that project streams of burning gel, these platoons carry one of the most psychologically devastating weapons available to conventional infantry. The short range and danger of carrying volatile fuel make flamer duty one of the most hazardous assignments in the platoon.
